description: Use when building or reviewing UI with the Tabler admin template (tabler.io) — which Tabler components/utilities exist, how to compose them, and (critically) the exceptions/workarounds needed to make Tabler and its companion vanilla JS behave in the target framework, especially Vue 3. Invoke for ANY Tabler markup decision: modals, dropdowns, badges/pills, grid columns, form inputs, icons, wizards, empty states, emails — in any Tabler app. Carries the living "don't use Tabler's X — use Y instead" exceptions list; consult it BEFORE using any Tabler interactive component. Do NOT use for component/state/data-access structure or UX flow decisions — that's the frontend skill; do NOT use for color/typography/spacing judgment — that's design-guide. This skill owns "which Tabler pieces, and do they break in this framework?"
